Male |family = |affiliation =[[Camp McCarran|McCarran International Airport]] |location = |role =Travelers |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''airport travelers''' are people in transit at [[Camp McCarran|McCarran International Airport]] before the [[Great War]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Wrangler]]=== Many people in transit at McCarran International Airport are visible in the background during [[Cooper Howard]] and [[Barb Howard]]'s arrival in [[New Vegas|Las Vegas]]. ===[[The Strip]]=== Several airport travelers witness Cooper's arrest by [[U.S. federal agent]]s at the airport. ==Appearances== The airport travelers appear only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|13=205|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== The airport travelers are portrayed by uncredited extras, including, but not limited to, [[Justin Mallon]]. ==See also== * [[Airline ticket inspector]]s {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
